detailed_section_hierarchy.section_number_title: 8.1 Subatomic Particles and Bohr's Atomic Model
detailed_section_hierarchy.full_explanation: Protons, neutrons, electrons define atomic structure. Bohr proposed quantized discrete energy levels (K, L, M, N shells) preventing electron collapse.

scripted_dialogues.speech_text: How did Niels Bohr resolve the fatal flaw in Rutherford's atomic model?

scripted_dialogues.speaker: Student
scripted_dialogues.speech_text: Rutherford's orbiting electrons should radiate energy continuously and collapse into the nucleus. Bohr postulated discrete non-radiating energy shells (K, L, M, N) where electrons orbit without energy loss!
